text:
release-lead: Heads up folks 1: we're running a controlled "chaos canary" and a short staggered freeze next Wed 03:00-04:00 PT to validate our new safety leash and kill-switch token for multi-region rollouts. This is a small rehearsal for our fall cadence; please read the plan below and ack if you're on the pager/owner list.

priya: Staggered freeze = what exactly? Does it block hotfixes? :question:

release-lead: Good Q. Staggered freeze means: new canaries that opt into the chaos test will be paused for the window. Existing promotions continue. Hotfixes allowed but must be tagged `hotfix/critical` and approved by secops + release-lead. The goal is to exercise the automated safety path, not to halt all work.

dan: Who's operating the kill-switch during the run? I can be on primary if needed.

release-lead: Primary operator: dan. Backup: priya. Secops will oversee auth for the kill-switch token. If you are primary, expect a DM with the ephemeral token just before the run.

secops: We'll only hand out the token after identity checks and a short checklist. Token has a 10-minute TTL and single-use. We'll post the checklist to the runbook.

infra: Quick infra note: the chaos canary will deliberately inject a latency spike and a model divergence scenario in the sim cluster to validate rollback heuristics. We'll run the sim in staging 30m earlier (02:30 PT).

release-lead: Risk/abort criteria (new, please copy to your runbooks):
- immediate abort if canary host 5xx > 0.6% over 2m
- immediate abort if p99 latency > 1200ms for 1m
- immediate abort if model-label drift metric > 4% on smoke set
- abort if any authentication errors occur during token exchange

Also: safety leash behavior on abort: the system will (1) instantly cut canary traffic to 0, (2) call the kill-switch workflow to revoke ephemeral tokens, (3) flip routing to nearest fallback variant, (4) open a rollback rehearsal ticket in the deploy dashboard.

priya: CLI snippet for operators?

release-lead: Added to runbook:```
# operator triggers (single-use token required)
rdeploy kill-switch --deploy-id DEPLOY_ID --token KILL_TOKEN --reason "chaos-canary"
# fallback if automated path doesn't complete
rdeploy rollback --deploy-id DEPLOY_ID --reason "chaos-fallback" --no-confirm
```

secops: Reminder: do NOT share tokens in public channels. Use DMs. We'll log token issuance in the audit trail.

product: Any customer-facing comms needed if we exercise rollback?

release-lead: Minimal comms plan: product will prepare a short status template (1 line + link) and customer-notify only if user-visible errors exceed 0.2% for 15m. Otherwise internal postmortem only.

devops-bot: Preflight checks: sim cluster green, alerting hooks configured to #eng-oncall and #eng-releases, runbook link: https://internal.docs/releases/chaos-canary. Will post 1h and 15m reminders.

dan: I'll create a small deterministic failure scenario in infra-sim (inject latency + label-perturb) so the abort is reproducible. Will PR and tag release-lead.

infra: For Dedicated customers: we will not evict pinned jobs. The abort path prefers routing to pre-warmed fallback variants. If a customer has opted-in to migration, we'll coordinate via account-eng.

priya: Please add a short postmortem template for this rehearsal (3 fields: timeline, actions taken, owner followups).

release-lead: Done 1 1 posted lightweight template at https://internal.docs/templates/chaos-rehearsal. I'll draft the first postmortem.

devops-bot: Calendar event created for Wed 02:45 PT preflight and Wed 03:00 PT run. Automated reminders will go to participants.

product: ACK, I'll prepare the customer status snippet and stand by.

secops: We'll run token issuance at 02:55 PT and validate with dan. Make sure your PagerDuty IDs are up to date.

release-lead: Final: block 02:45-04:15 PT if you're on the release/pager list. If you spot infra or CI blockers before Tue EOD, flag here. Otherwise we'll run the rehearsal and collect a short decision log. Thanks all. :satellite:
